rules._daily_note: Bitfunded: realized loss of the day + floating loss of open positions vs a fixed daily% x initial. Auto-fails on FLOATING.
rules._reset_note: 00:00 UTC+8 = 16:00 UTC = 12:00 noon in New York (EDT). Reset lands MIDDAY local, not overnight. May take until 00:10 UTC+8 to apply.
rules._dd_note: Confirmed static: measured against account quota, not a high-water mark. Profit permanently widens the buffer.
rules._min_days_note: ToU 9(a) says 5 for every profile. The challenge page displays 0 - the contract governs.
rules._fee_note: 0.04% of notional at entry AND exit = 0.08% round trip.
rules._compliance_note: ToU 14(d): 10-day max hold, 10 open trades, ~65% margin anti-gambling, no marketed strategies, one active account per level (6b).
rules._margin_note: Cross 5x: the whole account backs every position. Exchange liquidation is unreachable at any size Bitfunded permits; the firm's 4%/6% floors are the effective liquidation model. Isolated would cut a runaway position at ~20% for its own margin; cross does not.
rules._mmr_note: Maintenance margin rate. Bitfunded's exact figure is NOT in their public docs; 0.5% is a typical major-perp rate. Confirm with support and update.
rules._basis_note: Bitfunded FAQ: daily limit is a FIXED amount from the INITIAL balance, resetting daily. Today's net P&L offsets it. Earlier versions of this config said day_start_balance - that was an unverified assumption.

1step._note: Tightest structure Bitfunded offers. Sizing that clears this clears anything.

2step_s1._note: 2.5x the room of 1-Step. Matters only above ~1.5% risk.

2step_s2._note: Shortest target. Cumulative with S1 is 13.4% compounded vs 10% for 1-Step.

trader_1step._note: Help centre, Challenge & Trader Stage (read 2026-09-23): 80% split, 1:5. Any Trader Stage breach disqualifies the account. Payouts capped at 3 per 30 days.

trader_express._note: Help centre, Challenge & Trader Stage (read 2026-09-23): 80% split, 1:5. Daily = max: both bind from the first dollar lost.

trader_2step._note: Help centre, Challenge & Trader Stage (read 2026-09-23): 80% split, 1:5.

express._note: Daily = max. Both ceilings bind from the first dollar lost. Crossover is the starting balance. Target 9% per the help centre (Challenge & Trader Stage); the 28 Aug 2026 blog says 3%; the Terms are silent on Express.

instant._note: Confirmed Bitfunded blog 2026-08-28. No target, no min days, static, 60% profit share.
